title: Announced Fed implementation rates effective September 17, 2026

rows.label: Reserve-balance interest
rows.metric_source_text: interest rate paid on reserve balances
rows.support_excerpt: The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System voted unanimously to raise the interest rate paid on reserve balances to 3.90 percent, effective September 17, 2026.
rows.value_context: raise the interest rate paid on reserve balances to 3.90 percent

rows.label: Standing overnight repo
rows.support_excerpt: "Effective September 17, 2026, the Federal Open Market Committee directs the Desk to: Undertake open market operations as necessary to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent. Conduct standing overnight repurchase agreement operations at a rate of 4.0 percent. Conduct standing overnight reverse repurchase agreement operations at an offering rate of 3.75 percent and with a per-counterparty limit of $160 billion per day.
rows.value_context: Conduct standing overnight repurchase agreement operations at a rate of 4.0 percent.

rows.metric_source_text: standing overnight reverse repurchase agreement operations
rows.support_excerpt: "Effective September 17, 2026, the Federal Open Market Committee directs the Desk to: Undertake open market operations as necessary to maintain the federal funds rate in a target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent. presentation: One categorical comparison of three administered settings for the same effective date; no historical line or forecast. Keep original numeric spelling in source bindings; code owns numeric parsing and rendering.
limits: ANNOUNCED_POLICY, not observed market rates. No prior series or realized pass-through data supplied. The reverse-repo counterparty limit is not a fourth rate; primary credit is not substituted for standing repo.
